scientific_limitations: Only Haar SO(3), two congruent three-dimensional side-two cubes, upper-endpoint asymptotics and the associated high positive moments; complete distribution and higher-dimensional cases unproved. title: Sharp Haar endpoint tail for the Minkowski sum of two cubes
